🧠 Crypto News Brief: Risk-off returns: an oil spike on Iranian tanker attacks dragged Bitcoin below $84K and flushed leveraged longs, while Coinbase, Robinhood and OKX kept building for the long game. 📉 Bitcoin Slips Below $84K as Oil Spikes on Iranian Tanker Attacks Bitcoin fell as low as about $83,840 early Wednesday after Iran stepped up attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, pushing Brent above $101 and lifting the dollar and the 10-year Treasury yield to 5.31%. Ether lost roughly 3.5% and DOGE about 5%, with crypto liquidations climbing past $540 million. Traders now await minutes from the Fed's September meeting, due later today. Read full story 🏛️ Coinbase Revives Coinbase Pro and Launches Coinbase Global Exchange Coinbase completed its Deribit integration, creating Coinbase Global Exchange and, for the first time, linking U.S. and international crypto derivatives into a single liquidity pool under CFTC guidance. Deribit-powered options, spot margin of up to 10x on major assets and unified portfolios roll out in the coming weeks, while a rebuilt Coinbase Pro returns by year-end for spot, futures, perps, options and equities. More details 🤝 OKX Raises From Standard Chartered, Circle and Ripple at $25B Valuation OKX secured fresh investment from Circle, Ripple, quant firm Qube Research and Technologies and Standard Chartered's SC Ventures at a $25 billion pre-money valuation, extending ICE's March deal. The exchange is repositioning as a global fintech platform, and its joint venture with the NYSE owner has filed to offer 24/7 trading in tokenized shares of 63 U.S. companies settled in stablecoins. See details 🟢 Robinhood Adds $25 Million in Bitcoin to Its Balance Sheet Robinhood has bought $25 million worth of BTC, SVP Johann Kerbrat told The Block, framing it as a signal of alignment with the crypto community rather than a move that changes the trajectory of the roughly $100 billion company. The purchase lands as Robinhood readies U.S. perpetual futures and its Robinhood Chain layer 2 tops $1 billion in total value locked. Read more 🇺🇸 U.S. Government Moves $100M+ in Seized BTC and BNB Wallets linked to the U.S. government moved about $71.6 million in bitcoin seized in fraud and Bitfinex hack cases, which ended up at Coinbase Prime deposit addresses, plus $31.6 million in BNB seized from Alameda Research, according to Arkham data. 80395.subject: 📉 Bitcoin breaks down as S&P hits new highs
80395.body:
———————————————————————————

## Top Stories

**BTC** $83,577 (-3.1%) | **ETH** $2,574 (-5.2%) | **SOL** $117 (-2.7%)

* Bitcoin falls below [$84,000](https://x.com/WatcherGuru/status/2107653450045739368) as over $400 million in longs get liquidated —Bitcoin ETFs pull in $118M while Ethereum ETFs see [$201M](https://x.com/Cointelegraph/status/2107695225388876210) in outflows

* Abstract L2 announces their chain will be [shutting down](https://x.com/AbstractChain/status/2107554632675340420?s=20) this December

* S&P 500 futures hit a record high, pushing its market cap above [$71 trillion](https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2107436411259691218)

* The 30-year Treasury yield climbs 5bps to 5.70%, the [highest since 2002](https://x.com/zerohedge/status/2107775423656702117?s=20)

* US government-linked wallets move [834 BTC](https://x.com/BitcoinNews/status/2107619995035287800) and 40,285 BNB, with BTC going to Coinbase Prime

* Tom Lee says BitMine will [stop buying ETH](https://x.com/coinbureau/status/2107763103756878003) at a 5% hard cap

* Robinhood adds [$25M of Bitcoin](https://x.com/WatcherGuru/status/2107773202219102227?s=20) to balance sheet

* Anthropic expands its [Cyber Verification Program](https://x.com/AnthropicAI/status/2107546569654636883), opening Claude Mythos 5.1, Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 to verified security pros and adding tiers for authorized offensive work

* Winklevoss Capital files for a spot Zcash ETF to list on Nasdaq under ticker [WINK](https://x.com/solidintel_x/status/2107495381496181146)

* Polymarket announces [Protocol V2](https://x.com/WuBlockchain/status/2107324478887972938), targeting a full mainnet switchover on November 2

* Russia's Sberbank gets approved as a [crypto custodian](https://x.com/solidintel_x/status/2107756129761755198)

* Paxos' $3 billion USDG stablecoin launches on Arbitrum as it proposes [100M ARB](https://cointelegraph.com/news/paxos-3b-usdg-stablecoin-launches-arbitrum) in incentives

* Roman Storm says the DOJ is still pursuing his [Tornado Cash](https://cryptobriefing.com/doj-roman-storm-fincen-drops-mixer-proposal/) case after it drops the mixer rule

* Dune dashboard wizard Adam Tehc launches [memecoin trench index website](https://x.com/tehcscreener/status/2107653864925052978?s=20)

———————————————————————————


———
